scripts.cicd:check: npm run clean && npm ci && npm run bundle
scripts.cicd:test: npm run clean && npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run format-check && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.clean:
printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Purging outputs and caches...' && concurrently -n clean: -g npm:clean:*
scripts.clean:modules:
printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Cleaning node_modules and package-lock.json...' && rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json
scripts.clean-cache:
printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Cleaning npm cache...' && npm cache clean --force
scripts.clean-all: npm run clean-cache && npm run clean:modules && npm run clean:coverage && npm run clean:dist
scripts.bundle: npm run check && npm run build && npm run package
scripts.fix:
printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Formatting and linting...' && concurrently -n fix: -g npm:fix:*
scripts.local-test:
sh script/test || if [ $? -eq 127 ]; then printf '\033[1;33m%s `%s`\033[0m
' 'script/test can be generated by running' 'sh script/test.example'; fi
scripts.package:watch:
printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Packaging project in watch mode...' && npm run package:rollup -- --watch
scripts.coverage: npm test && npm run coverage:badge && npm run coverage:summary
scripts.coverage:badge:
printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Generating coverage badge...' && npm run badge-cli
scripts.coverage:summary:
printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Coverage summary totals...' && node -e "import('fs').then(fs => { const summary = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('coverage/coverage-summary.json', 'utf-8')); console.log(summary.total); })"
scripts.docs:
printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Preparing documentation...' && npm run docs:clean && npm run docs:generate
scripts.docs:generate:action:
printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Generating action docs...' && npx typedoc --options typedoc.action.json
scripts.docs:generate:toolkit:
printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Generating toolkit docs...' && npx typedoc --options src/toolkit/typedoc.json
scripts.docs:clean:action:
printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Cleaning action docs directory...' && rm -rf docs
scripts.docs:clean:toolkit:
printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Cleaning toolkit docs directory...' && rm -rf src/toolkit/docs
scripts.package-lock:fix: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const f = 'package-lock.json'; const c = fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8').trimEnd(); fs.writeFileSync(f, c + '\n');"
scripts.posttest:
printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Checking for circular dependencies...' && npx madge --circular --extensions ts,js ./src
scripts.postinstall:
npm run package-lock:fix && printf '\033[1;32m%s:\033[0m\033[0;32m %s\033[0m
' 'Installation complete' 'Run `npm run build` to build the project.'
scripts.setup:
printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Setting up environment...' && npm run install:concurrently
scripts.reset: npm run setup && npm run clean && npm install
scripts.prep: npm run fix && npm run compile && npm test && npm run package
scripts.all: npm run reset && npm run fix && npm run coverage && npm run bundle && npm run docs
